text.description_html:
6" x 20" Endurance PVD Polished Brass Kick Plate

The 6 x 20 Endurance PVD Polished Brass Kick Plate is made of .050 inch thick stainless steel. Packaged with mounting screws for easy installation.

Specifications

  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Finish: PVD Polished Brass
  • Plate Height: 6"
  • Plate Width: 20"
  • Plate Thickness: .050" (1.2 mm)
  • Packaged with Brass Mounting Screws

Note: Kick Plates are typically the width of the door less 2 inches. If your door is 42 inches wide you would install a 40 inch wide kick plate. Please measure your door/s for proper fit.

Custom item, No RETURNS
